adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` without any `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()`, which has `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). If the DELETE request fails (403/404/500), the promise rejection is unhandled and no `popupAjaxError` is shown to the admin, leaving the UI with no explicit error feedback and the row not removed (since `deleteHost` is only sent on success).
